messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Adderall (mixed amphetamine and dextroamphetamine salts) is a central nervous system stimulant used to treat attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and a sleep disorder called narcolepsy. Adderall contains a combination of amphetamine and dextroamphetamine, which affect chemicals in the brain and nerves that contribute to hyperactivity and impulse control.
- For ADHD, Adderall is used in children 3 to 17 years of age and in adults. It may help increase attention and decrease impulsiveness and hyperactivity.
- For narcolepsy, Adderall is used in people 6 years and older.
It is not known if Adderall is safe and effective for ADHD in children under 3 years of age or for narcolepsy in children under 6 years of age.
Adderall is a federally controlled substance (CII) because it contains amphetamine, which can be a target for people who abuse prescription medicines or street drugs. Keep Adderall in a safe place to protect it from theft. Never give your Adderall to anyone else, because it may cause death or harm them. Selling or giving away Adderall is against the law.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has patient instruction", "never give to anyone else"]

The relation 'has patient instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients should follow the instruction specified by the object entity when using the subject drug to ensure safety and prevent harm.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
B. 'has missed dose instruction': If a dose of the subject drug is missed the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has instruction': The subject drug includes a directive for the patient to perform the action specified by the object entity.
E. 'has storage instruction': The subject drug should be stored according to the instruction specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
